title: Favorites Ceiling Focus, Fast Updates, Seamless Navigation & Credential Gating
releaseNotes:
• Favorites Ceiling Focus: Favorites is now the hard ceiling focus in categories; pressing Up stays in categories and never escapes to Search
• Channels-to-Search Navigation: Pressing D-Pad Up from top channel navigates directly to Search in TV/desktop mode
• Unblocked Channel Navigation: Guaranteed instant Right navigation from categories to channels under all conditions without unmounting list
• 10x Faster Downloads: Overhauled OTA update downloads with 128KB buffered I/O and throttled progress updates to download at full wire speed
• Media Transition Hardening: Isolated streaming sockets and added stream generation tokens to eliminate disruptions and stale recovery timers
• Verified Credential Gating: Music and Podcasts are strictly gated behind verified active credentials
